conditional_finding.classification: Representable source/API and conditional native replay discrepancy; supported state reachability, policy, transaction semantics, alias and actual effect remain open. This label is a reconciliation aid, not an accepted unique-count or closure decision.
conditional_finding.premises: Assume the same recipient has two positive foreign blood deposits of a starter blood-compatible disease, at strategic minutes 0 and 10, both present in the native reader; replay is (0,10], the disease checkpoint is absent or does not skip minute 1, route and exposure calculations are otherwise admitted, and the work budget permits that minute. For a concrete mathematical comparison, each deposit may have amount 1, with finite cut_route 0 and blood_compatible true; the sum remains below the source clamp.
conditional_finding.window_trace: core filth.rs:90–132 uses an excluded starting cursor and produces [1,10] for the deposit at 0 and [10,10] for the deposit at 10, because the infectious duration is 2 × 1,440 minutes (filth.rs:11–12; calendar.rs:10). The windows overlap and merge, so minute 1 is iterated because the older deposit is active. The future deposit alone would not produce minute 1 in its own window.
conditional_finding.dose_trace: The native reader loads retained recipient deposits without an at-minute filter; relevant_blood_deposits filters foreign status and disease but not deposit time (native filth.rs:310–348; blood_attempts.rs:19–20, 33–47, 103–117). At each selected minute the native caller supplies the entire relevant collection to core blood_exposure (blood_attempts.rs:64–75). At minute 1 the future deposit's age uses 1.saturating_sub(10)=0 (calendar.rs:144–150), so infectious_fraction returns 1 (core filth.rs:81–87). blood_exposure_for_vector sums that deposit despite deposited_at>now (190–208). With the stated two unit amounts and route, its source-level core dose is strictly larger than the older deposit alone, before downstream native protections.
conditional_finding.limits: This does not establish that a future row was actually stored, that native state is reachable under supported chronological producers, that an AcquisitionAttempt or infection occurs, or that intended policy requires a particular result. Native checkpoint state, successful database reads, nonzero budget, residual-exposure and other disease controls matter; source-level per-minute dose is not a runtime outcome.

Establish historical deposit retention, all actual clock writers, plan lifecycle, transaction ordering and input policy before promoting this to an observed or product-reachable defect.
